def transform(grid):
    # Fill the hollow square with 2x2 blocks in a checker crossing arrangement,
    # using the colors of the markers below the frame.
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    n = len(g)
    marks = [(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(n) for c in range(len(g[r])) if g[r][c] not in (0,5)]
    if len(marks) < 2:
        return g
    colors = [m[2] for m in marks[-2:]]
    # locate frame bounding rectangle
    cells = [(r,c) for r in range(n) for c,v in enumerate(g[r]) if v == 5]
    r0,r1 = min(r for r,c in cells), max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0,c1 = min(c for r,c in cells), max(c for r,c in cells)
    h,w = r1-r0-1,c1-c0-1
    for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        for c in range(c0+1,c1):
            # quadrants checker layout; markers correspond left/right top row
            q = (r-r0-1)//(h//2), (c-c0-1)//(w//2)
            g[r][c] = colors[(q[0]+q[1])%2]
    return g
PY

def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    frame = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(g) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    if not frame:
        return g
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in frame), max(r for r, c in frame)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in frame), max(c for r, c in frame)
    marks = [(r, c, g[r][c]) for r, row in enumerate(g)
             for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0, 5)]
    if len(marks) < 2:
        return g
    a, b = marks[0][2], marks[1][2]
    markers_below = all(r > r1 for r, c, _ in marks[:2])
    h, w = r1 - r0 - 1, c1 - c0 - 1
    for r in range(r0 + 1, r1):
        for c in range(c0 + 1, c1):
            top = (r - r0 - 1) < h // 2
            left = (c - c0 - 1) < w // 2
            # Markers below seed the opposite diagonal: nearest left marker
            # fills the lower-left and upper-right quadrants.
            use_a = (top != left) if markers_below else (top == left)
            g[r][c] = a if use_a else b
    return g
PY
